pe-0b4U.title: Landscape: dry desert west, rainforest east
pe-0b4U.summary: A dry desert in the west and tropical rainforest in the east.

pe-0ozh.title: Plants: light green lichen on rocks
pe-0ozh.summary: Patches of light green lichen cover rocks and ground at high elevations in the centre and south.

pe-1XZ8.title: Pole: painted black or black-yellow bottom
pe-1XZ8.summary: Some poles have their bottom section painted black or black and yellow. Unique within South America, though Colombia has similar ones.

pe-2M5l.title: Google car: low Gen 4 'smallcam'
pe-2M5l.summary: Gen 4 camera mounted lower than usual, with a big round blur and a small bump at the front. In South America only Brazil and Argentina also have it.

pe-40vq.title: Landscape: dry, flat, few shrubs, some rolling hills
pe-40vq.summary: In the south-west of one northern region: dry, mostly flat land with few shrubs and sometimes rolling hills.

pe-592g.title: Coverage: wetter season north of the big lake
pe-592g.summary: Coverage north of the big lake was taken in a much wetter season than the south side.

pe-5Huy.title: Landscape: flat plain with trees and villages
pe-5Huy.summary: The valley between two central cities is a flat plain with plenty of trees, farms and small villages, with north-south mountains on both sides.

pe-5e7H.title: Landscape: exposed rock outcrops in hillsides
pe-5e7H.summary: In higher areas near the centre, bare rock outcrops on hill and mountain sides. Densest from a high lake south toward a southern city. They are rare elsewhere, so be careful.

pe-5xKh.title: Landscape: marshy shallow lake with mountains east
pe-5xKh.summary: A shallow marshy lake with a mountain range to the east. It looks like the big high lake, but has fewer people and trees.

pe-8cvB.title: Sign: black-and-white striped signposts
pe-8cvB.summary: The only South American country with black-and-white striped signposts, sometimes black and yellow. Uruguay paints traffic light poles that way, but not sign posts.

differs.how: Uruguay only stripes traffic lights, not sign posts

pe-8nBc.title: Road: undivided coastal highway, red soil, Gen 4
pe-8nBc.summary: Road 1S south of the southern desert city is not divided and follows the coast. Soil is often red or orange with almost no plants, and it is all Gen 4.

pe-Aqvn.title: Lamp posts: inverted J curve at the top
pe-Aqvn.summary: Street lamp posts in the capital region often curve at the top like an upside-down J. Also occasionally in two Amazon cities.

pe-Bs5J.title: Plants: pine plantations at altitude
pe-Bs5J.summary: Pine plantations in higher areas, away from the coastal desert and Amazon, mostly two planted species.

pe-C4Zg.title: Landscape: flat east, mountainous west
pe-C4Zg.summary: Flat in the east and mountainous in the west, except for a flat desert in the north-west.

pe-C6mO.title: Landscape: tall mountains with sharp rocky tops
pe-C6mO.summary: Taller central mountains often have rocky, sharp tops, stretching from the north-central city south to the big southern tourist city, away from the coast.

pe-CVON.title: Landscape: dry ridge north of a southern city
pe-CVON.summary: A distinct dry ridge to the north of the far-southern city.

pe-CeBf.title: Plants: coconut palms in coastal farmland
pe-CeBf.summary: Coconut and other tall palms in coastal farm areas, mainly north of the capital.

pe-CeXj.title: Farming: banana plants near the north coast
pe-CeXj.summary: Banana plants grow in farmland near the coast in the northern half.

pe-DIQR.title: Currency: 'S/' symbol
pe-DIQR.summary: The currency is the sol, shown as S/, which you can occasionally spot on signs. Unique to this country.

pe-ENXi.title: Vehicles: tuk tuks with open front
pe-ENXi.summary: Tuk tuks with an open front compartment, mostly in the northern half, especially near the northern Amazon.

pe-EoKI.title: Google car: Gen 4 exists, unlike its neighbour
pe-EoKI.summary: This country has Gen 4 coverage, but Bolivia does not. Ecuador's Gen 4 always uses a large pickup truck.

differs.how: Ecuador's Gen 4 is a big pickup truck

pe-Fr59.title: Farming: big sugar cane fields on the north coast
pe-Fr59.summary: Most sugar cane is on the northern coast near two big cities, in large fields. Smaller areas appear in southern coastal valleys.

pe-Hw0b.title: Road: divided highway on the coast
pe-Hw0b.summary: Highway 1 is divided in the highlighted area, the only divided highway outside cities.

pe-ILfq.title: Marker: black-and-white concrete km post
pe-ILfq.summary: Kilometre markers are concrete and painted black and white. Near towns they sometimes show the road number.

pe-Ig22.title: Houses: red brick and colonial, mountains all around
pe-Ig22.summary: A southern city with lots of red brick and Spanish colonial buildings, mountains on all sides and an airport in the middle. It resembles La Paz in Bolivia.

pe-IidK.title: Landscape: sandy soil, green or withered bushes
pe-IidK.summary: Off-road tracks in the far north-west have sandy soil with green or dry bushes. No black cars there, so a white car fits.

pe-JGX2.title: Coverage: isolated Amazon city, Gen 3 only
pe-JGX2.summary: A remote north-east city with only Gen 3 coverage: tuk tuks, overcast skies and rolling Amazon landscapes. It is cut off from other northern coverage.

pe-JcSb.title: Houses: red brick, more near the big lake
pe-JcSb.summary: Red brick houses become more common near the big high lake, like western Bolivia. Blue-tinted glass is common there too. Red brick appears anywhere, so check other clues.

pe-KObV.title: Plate: white or yellow, taxi two-tone
pe-KObV.summary: Plates are white or yellow, white being much more common. Taxis often have yellow on top and white below. In South America yellow plates also appear in Colombia and rarely Chile.

pe-LuyA.title: Landscape: farm valleys between bare mountains
pe-LuyA.summary: In the middle and south, farm valleys run south-west to north-east between dry mountains with no plants. Northern ones look similar but have more shrubs and trees on the mountains.

pe-Lxep.title: People: motorcycle taxi drivers in yellow vests
pe-Lxep.summary: In one Amazon city, motorcycle taxi drivers often wear yellow safety vests.

pe-NIjJ.title: Bollard: cylindrical, black-and-yellow stripe on top
pe-NIjJ.summary: A cylindrical bollard with black and yellow stripe at the top, unique to one southern region. It can look round and white with orange and black marks on top.

pe-NelL.title: Objects: rectangular metal meter with slits
pe-NelL.summary: Electricity meters are rectangular and metallic, with two or three horizontal slits, a bit like a post box.

pe-OFne.title: Landscape: same dry shrubs but noticeably hillier
pe-OFne.summary: North-west of that city, similar plants but noticeably hillier.

pe-REls.title: Soil: dark red-tinted
pe-REls.summary: Dark red-tinted soil near several southern and northern cities, and a bit in neighbouring regions.

pe-RGbm.title: Coverage: trekker along a train track
pe-RGbm.summary: A trekker covers a train track between a remote town and the Cusco area.

pe-S1FS.title: Landscape: volcanoes near the southern city
pe-S1FS.summary: Volcanoes are often seen around one southern city. In this country they are only in the south-east.

pe-UBbs.title: Vehicles: mototaxis (tuk tuks) everywhere
pe-UBbs.summary: Three-wheeled mototaxis are frequent, especially in the big cities.

pe-WEkO.title: Pole: concrete or wood, horizontal concrete bars
pe-WEkO.summary: Poles are concrete or wood, sometimes with distinct horizontal concrete bars. Argentina has those bars too.

pe-X2Hq.title: Road: small, faded lines, hillside above river
pe-X2Hq.summary: Road 28B is a small paved road with faded or missing lines in Gen 4, hugging a hillside next to a river valley.

pe-YZbB.title: Google car: solid black or white Gen 3 car
pe-YZbB.summary: Gen 3 uses a solid black or solid white car. Black also appears in Argentina and Uruguay, white in Bolivia and Chile.

pe-YfpD.title: Google car: white car on the route to ruins
pe-YfpD.summary: A white Street View car drives from a remote town up to the famous mountain ruins, in the Cusco area.

pe-Yqla.title: Signs: local political party logos
pe-Yqla.summary: Many political party logos appear, all unique to the country.

pe-Zzyx.title: Landscape: medium foliage-covered mountains, Amazon
pe-Zzyx.summary: Around a northern Amazon city: moderately tall mountains covered in foliage, resembling hilly parts of Colombia or Brazil.

pe-aCtw.title: Road: straight flat good road through rainforest
pe-aCtw.summary: Road 5N is a straight, flat road in good condition, running north-south through rainforest.

pe-akzm.title: Houses: colonial, boxy, red brick
pe-akzm.summary: Mixed architecture: colonial-era buildings, modern boxy buildings and traditional red brick houses.

pe-e8pi.title: Landscape: flat highland plain
pe-e8pi.summary: A flat landscape in the mountains, mostly in central Puno and around a high marshy lake. It can look like Bolivia.

pe-eOh8.title: Coverage: mostly west and main highways
pe-eOh8.summary: Coverage is mostly in the west and on main highways, with a few exceptions in the east near the Amazon city and along road 30C.

pe-hRI9.title: Landscape: semi-arid mountains and valleys
pe-hRI9.summary: Mostly semi-arid mountain ranges and valleys.

pe-j7qH.title: Plants: olive plantations in the far south
pe-j7qH.summary: Olive tree plantations in the far southern region.

pe-j9zr.title: Landscape: low grass, stone walls, brown brick
pe-j9zr.summary: Low grass, a few hills, stone-walled villages and brown brick buildings, south of a huge high-altitude lake.

pe-lWmR.title: Vehicles: wide red and white side stickers
pe-lWmR.summary: Wide red and white stickers on the side of taxis and commercial vehicles. A few neighbouring countries have them less often.

pe-lm-2452.title: Bollard: Moquegua colours in other prism shapes
pe-lm-2452.summary: Bollards with the black, yellow and white scheme of the southern region's bollards, but triangular or square, sometimes with white and red reflectors, on the 38A through Tacna and Puno and the 3S south of Ilave. In Gen 3 it points to the coastal town Ilo.

pe-lm-2453.title: Bollard: half-buried bollards and loose white rocks
pe-lm-2453.summary: Around Locumba, between two southern regions, bollards look like half-buried versions of the southern type, mixed with sections of just loose white rocks.

pe-lm-3135.title: Coverage: dark red sunset, eerie clouds
pe-lm-3135.summary: East of one coastal city, a road where the sunset and clouds made the footage look hellish.

pe-lm-465853.title: Bollard: only on the highway north of the capital
pe-lm-465853.summary: This bollard appears only on the 1N highway north of the capital, within the capital's region.

pe-lm-465854.title: Bollard: only on the coast road between two cities
pe-lm-465854.summary: These bollards appear only on the 1S highway between Ica and the capital.

pe-lm-465855.title: Bollard: almost only in the far south
pe-lm-465855.summary: This bollard is almost only in the far-southern region, spilling a bit into its neighbour.

pe-lm-626.title: Pole: yellow sticker with sideways black numbers
pe-lm-626.summary: In the wider Cusco area up to the border tri-point with Brazil and Bolivia, concrete poles sometimes have yellow stickers with black numbers running sideways.

pe-lm-627.title: Pole: two horizontal yellow stickers
pe-lm-627.summary: Two horizontal yellow stickers with black text on concrete poles, in a corridor between Tingo Maria and Ayacucho.

pe-lm-628.title: Pole: white sticker with blue text
pe-lm-628.summary: A white sticker with blue text on a pole means the very south, below Arequipa.

pe-lm-629.title: Pole: vertical white sticker, blue or red numbers
pe-lm-629.summary: A vertical white sticker with blue or red numbers places you in Arequipa Province.

pe-lm-630.title: Landscape: flat jungle, no mountains, good road
pe-lm-630.summary: Roads 18C/5N and 30C are almost the only places with a flat profile, no mountains, a good road and lush, slightly yellow-tinted jungle. 30C has almost no clouds, 18C/5N always has big clouds.

pe-lm-67041.title: Road: black Gen 3 car, no centre line, Amazon hills
pe-lm-67041.summary: The road to the Amazon city shows a black Gen 3 car, no centre lines and rolling Amazon landscape.

pe-mbNm.title: Landscape: shrubby mountains, dry near the coast
pe-mbNm.summary: In the far north, mountains often covered in shrubby trees and bushes. Closer to the coast and the border they look quite dry.

pe-n8zM.title: Landscape: barren flat desert with mountains east
pe-n8zM.summary: Barren, mostly flat desert near three southern cities. Mountains show in the distance, mainly to the east. It can resemble northern Chile.

pe-nK4d.title: Google car: white Gen 3 car, jungle road
pe-nK4d.summary: Road 30C in the east has a white Gen 3 car with dense forest and few villages, resembling interior Brazil. Parts are overwritten by Gen 4.

pe-o1h4.title: Guardrail: black and yellow stripes
pe-o1h4.summary: Black-and-yellow striped guardrails are common. Bolivia has similar ones, but look at the outer stripe: black here, yellow in Bolivia.

differs.how: Bolivia's outer stripe is yellow, here it is black

pe-q8YX.title: Streets: grid running WSW to ENE
pe-q8YX.summary: An Amazon city near the Brazil border has a consistent street grid running west-south-west to east-north-east, though some northern and eastern areas differ.

pe-qYbM.title: Streets: long straight boulevards with median
pe-qYbM.summary: Boulevard-style streets, mostly in the capital: long, straight, divided by concrete or a grassy strip.

pe-r51J.title: Houses: overhanging roofs on wooden supports
pe-r51J.summary: Overhanging roofs with wooden supports, sometimes bright colours, mostly in the north.

pe-r5e9.title: Road lines: white outer, yellow middle
pe-r5e9.summary: Outer lines are always white. Highways have a single dashed or double yellow middle line. Rural mountain roads have white outer lines and no centre line. Divided highways may be all white.

pe-sBQ3.title: Sign: metal signpost on concrete blocks
pe-sBQ3.summary: Metal signposts stand on concrete blocks at the bottom. In South America only this country does that.

pe-tRd3.title: Pole: yellow vertical numbers, north coast
pe-tRd3.summary: Yellow vertical pole numbers on the northern coast and the far south, often with a horizontal sticker starting with a 2 or 3 letter city code, like CH.

pe-uSmV.title: Landscape: semidesert, overcast Gen 3
pe-uSmV.summary: Road 1N near the border of two northern regions: semidesert and overcast in Gen 3. Gen 4 is drier but looks similar.

pe-xFoX.title: Bollard: red or yellow triangular concrete
pe-xFoX.summary: Concrete bollards painted red or yellow, mostly triangular in shape. Round concrete ones appear occasionally.

pe-ztvL.title: Route numbers: highways in the west, rising south
pe-ztvL.summary: Highways are mainly in the west with numbers rising from north to south. Routes 1, 3 and 5 are the longest.
